title: Atmospheric Cloudbreak God Rays
subtitle: Henyey-Greenstein Scattering & Cumulus Cloudburst
description: Dramatic high-contrast volumetric sunburst piercing heavy cumulus cloud clusters. Calculates Henyey-Greenstein forward phase scattering with high-order cloud gap harmonics, gold edge back-lighting, and luminous aerosol dust motes.
mathNotation: P_{\text{HG}}(\cos \theta) = \frac{1 - g^2}{4\pi(1 + g^2 - 2g\cos\theta)^{3/2}}, \quad I(\mathbf{x}) = \int_0^L T(s) \sigma_s(\mathbf{x}(s)) P(\theta) \cdot L_i(\mathbf{x}(s)) \, ds
formulaCompact: P_HG(cos θ) = (1 - g²) / [4π (1 + g² - 2g cos θ)^(3/2)],  I(beam) = I_0 · P_HG(θ) · [1 - O_cloud]

parameters.label: Ray Sharpness
parameters.description: Forward phase eccentricity and focus of the light beams

parameters.description: Opacity and shadow depth of the cumulus cloud formations

parameters.description: Horizontal angle and diagonal trajectory of the sunburst
